== Summary ==
Identified: [[Chris Menzel]] (right). Remaining faces unlabeled.
Two people toasting at Oktoberfest in Munich on 26 September 2019, on the European trip after the [[2019 World Championship]] (Bochum, Germany, 20–22 September 2019). Posted with the caption "Entering Oktoberfest...let the real beer wars begin".
